title: SREV-153 spooler counted port name

source_change.description: spooler endpoint names compare through counted UNICODE_STRING equality

runtime_matrix.description: Windows driver and spooler endpoint matching proof

contracts: UNICODE_STRING.Length is a byte count and does not authorize C-string scans over Name->Name.Buffer
Spooler endpoint matching must compare counted strings with RtlEqualUnicodeString using RtlInitUnicodeString only for the expected NUL-terminated literal or dynamic port name
The Windows 8.1 dynamic spooler port gate still accepts only the cached dynamic spooler port name
The Vista fallback still accepts only RPC Control spoolss
this SREV does not change KPATH-006 RPC payload capture spooler opnum filtering dynamic-port publication OpenPrintSpooler or AllowSpoolerPrintToFile behavior
